spacebunny.lua.name: SpaceBunny
spacebunny.lua.description: Download interceptor: injects depots and decryption keys and resolves manifest request codes from several providers with circuit breakers.

styx.lua.name: Styx
styx.lua.description: Ownership ticket splicer so apps added through AdditionalApps pass SteamStub DRM checks.

lobster.lua.name: Lobster
lobster.lua.description: Restores AdditionalDepots and DecryptionKeys in config.yaml when an SLSsteam update strips them.

lettuce.lua.name: Lettuce
lettuce.lua.description: Proxy / ISP-block transport for the plugins' own requests (MRC providers, Hubcap), with a Cloudflare worker fallback. Formerly Bypass.

pineapple.lua.name: Pineapple
pineapple.lua.description: Manifest fallback: puts Hubcap manifests into Steam's depotcache before Steam asks, so updates work when every MRC provider is down. Formerly Bakeneko.
pineapple.lua.disabled_reason: Pineapple is still being finished and will be enabled in a future update.

hubcap.lua.reason: The Hubcap key resolver is retired; Pineapple replaces it.

katamari.lua.reason: The registry is no longer needed; katamari.conf.lua stays the shared config.

download.lua.reason: The Standard Interceptor is no longer published; SpaceBunny is the interceptor.
